hero.name: Teddy
hero.tagline: Building independence, one honest day at a time.
hero.sub: I'm a high-functioning kid sharing my real routines, real tools, and real progress — not for sympathy, just so other families can see how it actually works.

about.title: The short version
about.body1: I'm working on a 6-month independence project with my school — three real skills, small steps, honest check-ins. This site, and the videos that go with it, are the record of that.
about.body2: I'm not here to be inspiring. I'm here to show the specific things that actually help — the tools, the systems, the small wins — so families who are figuring out something similar have one less thing to guess at.
